meta.title: ANATOMICA lymphatic system inventory — Milestone 13
meta.source_tables: data/sources/bodyparts3d-4.0/ (BP3D 4.0 / FMA concept ids and names as released)
meta.counting_convention: One record for the spleen, keyed on its IS-A concept — the only table that carries it. One record for the thymus as an organ, keyed on its PART-OF concept (the Milestone 9 partof-organ pattern). One record per lateralised thymus lobe, keyed on its instance concept with the side-stripped class concept carried as class_concept_id (the Milestone 12 instance pattern). There is no lymphatic system root in the release to census as a grouping class: the string 'lymph' occurs in no concept name in either table.

totalsegmentator_overlap.note: of the 104 TotalSegmentator v1 labels (Milestone 3 census), exactly one is lymphatic: spleen, present in all 1,204 subjects. TS v1 has no thymus label and no node, vessel, trunk or duct label, so it adds no coverage the release lacks.

absences.note: probe-based gap analysis: each probe name was counted over all six BP3D 4.0 release tables. Zero hits = the name does not occur in the release.

fma_extension.source: Foundational Model of Anatomy (FMA) 5.1.0, data/sources/fma-5.1.0/ (CC BY 4.0)
fma_extension.counting_convention: one record per lateralised instance where the FMA carries both sided classes; one record keyed on the un-sided class otherwise — mirroring the Milestone 33 convention

ta2_pass.scope: the 131 FMA-sourced records of this inventory (Milestone 36 intake); the 4 BP3D-sourced records are untouched by this pass
ta2_pass.source: Terminologia Anatomica, 2nd edition (TA2), FIPAT 2019, TA version 2.07, as published in TA2Viewer; extracted table: data/sources/ta2-2.07/ta2-terms.json

records.name: spleen
records.note: the release carries the spleen in IS-A only, as a leaf under the generic class 'corticomedullary organ'; it occurs nowhere in the PART-OF table, and no part of it (pulp, hilum, trabecula) exists as a concept (probe-verified)

records.name: thymus
records.note: the release carries the thymus as an organ in PART-OF only, filed under 'content of anterior mediastinum'; the IS-A table carries no thymus organ concept, only the lobe line below

records.name: left lobe of thymus
records.note: lateralised instance; the side-stripped class concept is carried as class_concept_id (Milestone 12 pattern). The instance is a part of the thymus in PART-OF and an instance of the lobe class in IS-A

records.name: right lobe of thymus
records.note: lateralised instance; the side-stripped class concept is carried as class_concept_id (Milestone 12 pattern). The instance is a part of the thymus in PART-OF and an instance of the lobe class in IS-A
